senses.gloss:
† कुण् कुण्, i. 6, Par.
 1. To sound.
 2. To cherish; to support (or to pain).
 --i. 10, Par. कुणय,
 1. To address.
 2. To converse with.
 3. To invite.
 --Cf. क्वण्.
कूण् कूण् (derived from कुष्णा, the base of the present of कुष्), i. 10, Par., Ātm. To contract; कूणित, Suśr. 1, 362, 1.

कुणप कुणप,
 I. m. and n.
 1. A dead body, carrion, Man. 12, 71.
 II. m.
 2. A spear, MBh. 14, 142.

कुणि कुणि (probably a form of कुष् + नि, cf. कूण्), m.
 1. A cripple with a crooked or withered arm, MBh. 3, 1270.
 2. The name of a prince, Bhāg. P. 9, 24, 13.
† कुण्ट् कुण्ट्, i. 1, Par. To maim (? v. r.).

कुण्ठ् कुण्ठ्, i. 1, Par.
 1. † To be maimed.
 2. † To be lazy.
 --† i. 10, Par. To cover (? v. r.).
 कुण्ठित,
 1. Blunt, Kumāras. 2, 20.
 2. Powerless, Rājat. 5, 138.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. वि वि, विकुण्ठित, Blunted, Ragh. 5, 44.

कुण्ठ कुण्ठ् + अ, adj. Blunt, Rām. 3, 32, 16.
 --Comp.
कुण्ठक कुण्ठ + क, m. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 6, 370.

† कुण्ड् कुण्ड्, i. 1, Par. To maim (?).
 --i. 1, Ātm. To heat.
 --i. 10, Par. To preserve.

कुण्ड कुण्ड,
 I. m., f. डी, and n. A pitcher, a jar, a water pot, MBh. 3, 14311.
 II. m. and n. A basin of water, MBh. 13, 4816; Rām. 4, 26, 4.
 III. n.
 1. A hole in the ground for receiving and preserving consecrated fire, MBh. 3, 8216.
 2. A vessel for holding coals, Rām. 5, 10, 16.
 IV. m.
 1. A son of an [] adulteress born before the death of the husband, Man. 3, 156; 174.
 2. The name of a Nāga or serpent, MBh. 1, 4828.
 3. A name of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10358.
 --Comp.

कुण्डक कुण्ड + क,
 1. A jar, Kathās. 4, 47.
 2. m. A proper name, MBh. 1, 6983.

कुण्डल कुण्डल.
 I. m. and n.
 1. A ring, Bhāg. P. 5, 23, 3.
 2. An ear-ring, Bhartṛ. 2, 63.
 II. m. The name of a Nāga, MBh. 1, 2154.
 III. f. ला, A proper name, Mārk. P. 21, 34.
 --When the latter part of a comp. adj., the f. is ला, e. g. शैल-, adj., f. ला, Surrounded by mountains, MBh. 3, 10943.
 स-, adj. With earrings.
कुण्डलिन् कुण्डलिन्, i. e. कुण्डल + इन्, adj., f. नी, Having earrings, MBh. 1, 7005.

कुण्डाशिन् कुण्डाशिन्, i. e. कुण्ड-आशिन्,
 I. adj. One who eats food offered by the son of an adulteress, Man. 3, 158.
 II. m.
 1. The name of a Nāga or serpent.
 2. A proper name, MBh. 1, 4553.

कुण्डिन् कुण्डिन्, i. e. कुण्ड + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी, Carrying a water pot, MBh. 3, 16016.
 II. m. A horse, MBh. 2, 2061(?).

कुण्डिन कुण्डिन,
 I. m. A proper name, MBh. 1, 3747.
 II. n. The name of a city, Nal. 21, 2.
